notes.title: Patch 3.9.5 with Killing Field mode added
notes.content: new Patch 3.9.5 is live on Beta branch, after few days will be pushed to default branch too, it has killing field mode added to it. this patch will be updated for some time next week for more contents like drivable vehicles in the same mode.

notes.title: Patch 3.9.1 with stable release
notes.content: This patch (on default branch) contains a lot of user submitted and internal bug fixes, making gameplay a lot smoother, friends bot option is currently removed and later will be available again with Multiplayer Co-Op enabled.

notes.title: New Halloween update
notes.content:
New Halloween update is live with lots of bug fixes as suggestion by the community along with enemy and player model changes, entire level overhaul, better AI code and third person added for player. 

first person and third person can be switched using either middle mouse button or pressing V key on the keyboard.
